lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then artefacts. Fabrics judged as photo-vs-render crops at matched physical scale (17 in = 0.43 m seat back width; q15 near backs ~215 px vs y_47300 ~135 px, render crops downsampled x0.63; e4 vs y_47306 x0.78). Candidate c6 (working tree on b88346e: re-processed photo-cut Y tiles, smaller pale-blue flecks, tick/mosaic contrast restored, diamond stars -20 % on a lighter ground, screen hood 1.5 cm narrower). Measurements: /tmp/claude-0/rater16B/ms.py (box mean, B/R, L p10/p50, p90/p50, hf = std of L minus 5 px box blur, bright = fraction of L > 1.5 x median). Crops: /tmp/claude-0/rater16B/sheet.png (q15 vs y_47300, e4 vs y_47306), z.png (q15 s3/s4 vs y_47300 s3/s4, matched scale). Lighting and QA camera placement noted, not scored.

issues.title: Fleck overcorrected: at row distance the fleck seats read as plain mid-blue (ground too light, flecks too faint)
issues.evidence: q15 s4 back #32406c L50 62, p90/p50 1.34, bright 0.04, hf 12 vs y_47300 s4 #27355b L50 47, 1.88, 0.17, 26; q15 s4 pad p90/p50 1.28 / bright 0.02 vs 1.81 / 0.19 (z.png). Close-up e4 pad now matches (1.60 / 0.13 vs 1.68 / 0.12), so the size is right; it is the ground level and fleck brightness that are off, and the pale-blue tint plus mip filtering averages them away at distance.
issues.fix: tex_y_fleck in make_swatches.py: darken the ground ~20 % (target L50 ~48, #28365c), keep the fleck size, and lift the fleck cores back toward near-white (#c8d4f0 rather than pale blue) so the core/ground ratio is ~2.5; target row-distance p90/p50 ~1.8, bright ~0.15. If mips still wash them out, add a small mip LOD bias (-0.5) for the fleck layer.
